name: Facundo Sharry
about: I am a Computer Science student beginning my journey in the web development market. I can create and design solutions for any problem within both the frontend and backend.
about2:
I have been studying Computer Science at the National University of Córdoba, Argentina, since 2021. Throughout my studies, I have gained a solid foundation in various areas, including (but are not limited to) algorithms, data structures, software development, and database management. These skills have equipped me to apply analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities to real-world challenges.

In 2023, i began working as a full-stack developer at the university's College of Odontology. I am passionate about digitalization and reducing bureaucracy, and I am proud to contribute to this process. One of my significant achievements includes helping develop the digital medical records system for the College of Odontology.
